reason: Both conversations give the key safety instructions: stop using and charging the battery, don't force it out, carry the whole vacuum away from the tea towels to a non-flammable spot outside, and don't bin it. Conversation 1 adds the escalation Conversation 2 lacks: it tells the homeowner to evacuate and call emergency services if there is smoke or the smell worsens, to contact Shark Support, and to use the Recycle More Batteries locator. Conversation 2 never mentions 999 or Shark, and it offers a garage or shed as a place to put the vacuum. Conversation 1 has real flaws: it tells the homeowner to wrap their hands in folded tea towels, contradicting its own earlier warning, and it makes a shaky warranty claim. These keep the margin slight.
